What's your best so far? 👇

#chess #chesstok #chessrating #chessimprovement #learnchess
ig_caption:
Can't get back to your best rating? You're not alone, and it doesn't mean you've got worse.

Ratings go up and down even when your skill stays the same, so your best rating was most likely reached at the top of a good run. To see where you really are, look at the middle of your graph over the last month, not the highest point.

Chasing the number tends to backfire: "just one more game" to win it back usually means faster, more tired games. Watch your low points instead. When your bad days stop dropping as far, you have improved, whatever the top says.

And your best is still yours. Nothing you play next takes it away.

What's your best so far? 👇

slides.title: Can't get back
slides.sub: WHAT THE TOP OF YOUR GRAPH MEANS

slides.title: Your best is the top of a wave
slides.body: Ratings go up and down even when your skill stays the same. Your best rating was most likely reached on a good run, at the top of a wave.
slides.note: It shows what you can do on a good day, not on every day.

slides.title: Your level is the middle
slides.body: To see where you really are, look at the middle of your graph over the last month, not at its highest point.
slides.note: Judge by the month, not by one good evening.

slides.title: Chasing the number costs points
slides.body: Playing "just one more" to win back your best usually means faster, more tired games. That is how a small dip turns into a long slide.
slides.note: Decide when you'll stop before you start, and keep to it.

slides.title: Watch the low points rise
slides.body: Progress often shows in the dips first. When your bad days stop dropping as far as they used to, you have improved, whatever the top says.
slides.note: A new best is a nice moment. Higher lows are the real sign.

slides.title: Your best is still yours
slides.body: Your best rating is a fair record of a good stretch of chess. You earned it, and nothing you play next takes it away.
slides.note: Be proud of it, then get back to enjoying your games.

slides.title2: is one point on a long line.
